sentence: This project provides tools and expertise to study immune cells, including how they respond to immunotherapies for cancer.
This project studies how cancer predisposition affects the cancer process, its surroundings, and treatment.
This project tests whether a decision aid and a behavioral program help older adults with obstructive sleep apnea choose and use a treatment.
This project provides data and reagents to help understand how polycystic kidney disease develops and progresses.
This project studies how an enzyme called protein arginine methyltransferase works and what one of its targets does in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
This project studies how targeting normal myeloid cells harms chimeric antigen receptor T cells used against acute myeloid leukemia.
This project studies how hearing-related behavior in daily life links hearing loss to poor social-emotional health, and whether hearing aid use changes this.
This project studies how the hybrid capsid lattice helps a virus change from its immature form to its mature form.
This project studies unintended large gene modifications in gene editing for sickle cell disease and tries to reduce large deletions.
This project focuses on research into neurodegeneration and healthy aging.
This project builds imaging methods and tools that measure molecular features in cancer cells and tumors using multiplexed fluorescence microscopy.
This project uses deep learning to study how mobile element insertions affect alternative splicing in neurological disorders.
This project tests whether a restored dystrophin protein from gene editing can serve as a biomarker in Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
This project builds tools for sharing genomic and phenotypic data to help find the genes behind Mendelian phenotypes.
This project tests whether the cerebellum predicts the sequence of events to guide behavior in motor and cognitive function.
This project studies how dopamine-producing neurons in the zebrafish brain control movement through their neural targets.
This project builds a regional resource to help work out which gene variants cause inborn errors of immunity.
This project develops methods for composite null hypothesis testing to find genetic variants in genetic association studies.
This project develops a gene therapy that delivers an inflammasome adapter protein to treat schwannoma.
This project builds tools to control gene expression in human cells using synthetic constructs that trigger epigenetic memory.
